description: CaptureGPT archives requested web pages as downloadable WACZ files that users can replay in the browser. The service is free: users can start and track captures, retrieve prior captures, permanently delete an archive after an explicit confirmation step, check how many pages remain in their rolling free usage window, and get help opening archives. Nothing is sold, priced, or purchased in the conversation.
